description:
RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-mail-server --no-deps fails (default features) with:

  error: unresolved link to 'register_mdn_handlers'  --> src/lib.rs:22
  error: unresolved link to 'MdnBackend'             --> src/lib.rs:24

Both items are gated behind #[cfg(feature = "mdn")] (lib.rs:52, :258, etc.) but the //! crate doc-comment at lib.rs:22-24 references them unconditionally. cargo doc --all-features succeeds.

Two fixes:
1. Wrap the affected paragraph in a #[cfg_attr(feature = "mdn", doc = "...")] block so the link only renders when the feature is active.
2. Or remove the inline links and reference 'the MDN extension (feature mdn)' descriptively.

P3 because cargo doc with default features fails under -D warnings — would block docs.rs if docs.rs were configured to build with default features only (it usually auto-detects all-features, so this may be cosmetic). Either way it should compile under -D warnings without --all-features.

Pre-existing; surfaced while running rustdoc acceptance in a sibling pass. Unrelated to JMAP-sc1b.68.
title: rustdoc: jmap-mail-server lib.rs references feature-gated items in unconditional doc-comment
